response.sql: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS baseline_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals), combinations AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT c.*, c.avg_optvolrt - b.baseline_avg AS deviation FROM combinations AS c CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL), compared AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations AS d) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM compared WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL AND deviation > type_avg_deviation GROUP BY tradekind
